notes.title: Bug fix + small spoiler
notes.notes:
1) Fix Jaina hero Achievements bug.
2) Fix "Broken Tavern" bug. 

We are ashamed of these bugs and so we decided to show you what we are working on right now (the plot of the game):

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30957391/0dc1cdd7e7334f77c5e063cf73b8e93b5fb8b94c.jpg

All game plot will be in comics style like this. Hope you like it! Thank you guys!

notes.title: Bug fix + new features (15 November)
notes.notes:
1) Canceled the latest updates about speed in battle.
2) Change maximum game speed to x2. x4 bad for gameplay (to fast items grind) + bad FPS. Maybe we return x4 later.
3) Right click in forge to increase speed.
4) Some other bug fix and small improvements.

notes.title: Bug fix + new features
notes.notes:
Bug fix:
1) UI optimization for 16:10 screen,
2) New items in shop after battle win.
3) Card size in battle after return.
4) Better performance on x2 and x4 speed.
5) Small bug fix.

Features:
1) Sell and buy on right click.
